title: Weekly ARU detections of flammulated and northern pygmy owls at 517 recorder sites in 265 cells, northern Sierra Nevada, 2018 and 2021-2023
abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring of 265 hexagonal 400-ha cells (two ARUs per cell) in the northern Sierra Nevada, California, before and after the 2020 North Complex and 2021 Dixie fires and a 2018-2022 barred owl lethal-removal experiment. Weekly detection histories (11 weeks, May to July) for flammulated owl and northern pygmy owl at each ARU, with fire-severity, removal-treatment and barred owl covariates.
creator: Barry, Joshua; Wood, Connor; Jones, Gavin; McGinn, Kate; Kelly, Kevin; Kramer, Anu; Hofstadter, Daniel; Kahl, Stefan; Klinck, Holger; Kryshak, Nicholas; Dotters, Brian; Roberts, Kevin; Keane, John; Ng, Elizabeth; Peery, Zach
citation: Barry, J., Wood, C., Jones, G., McGinn, K., Kelly, K., Kramer, A., Hofstadter, D., Kahl, S., Klinck, H., Kryshak, N., Dotters, B., Roberts, K., Keane, J., Ng, E., Peery, Z. (2025). Data from: Divergent responses of native predators to severe wildfire and biological invasion are mediated by life history. Dryad. https://doi.org/10.5061/dryad.c866t1gkt
geographicCoverage: Lassen and Plumas National Forests (and adjacent private land), northern Sierra Nevada, California, USA; > 6,000 km2; no coordinates deposited
closureNote: occasion = one-week secondary period k (7 May + 7(k-1) days, k = 1..11, to 23 July); period = survey year (2018, 2021, 2022, 2023: 2019-2020 not used because barred owl removals overlapped the surveys). The authors assume closure within a year and fit stacked single-season models.
samplingProtocol: Autonomous recording units (two per 400-ha hexagonal cell, >= 500 m apart) recorded nightly 20:00-08:00 from early May to late July; audio scored with BirdNET at species x year thresholds for < 1% false positives per week, with predictions at lower thresholds manually validated for these two species; a survey is an ARU-week with recording.
surveyEvidenceNote: v1-v11: NA = not surveyed (no recording that week), 0/1 = surveyed; ARUhours is > 0 exactly where a week is scored, and the two species share the NA pattern at every ARU-week (asserted on the corrected files).

notShipped.author_corrections: The deposited FLM/NPO/GHO_data_stacked.csv values superseded by the authors' corrected files (see notes; differences counted in the script).
notShipped.date_covariates: date.1.1-date.1.11: a scaled week index (k/10), identical on every row; occasion carries it.
notShipped.FR_columns: FR11, FR22, FR33, FR12, FR23: present only in the corrected files. Removal-by-fire interaction terms, left out on the first author's advice (email); each is FRij = Bj x (pSevi > 0) (asserted), so it can be recomputed from period_b1-b3 and period_psev1-3.
notShipped.other_owls: Western screech owl and northern saw-whet owl were processed but excluded by the authors for few detections; not deposited.
notShipped.great_horned_owl: Great horned owl histories are at the cell level (two ARUs pooled), a different unit: they ship as barry_2025_sierra_gho_occ.

notes: y is the authors' weekly detection call from BirdNET (custom model) at species x year score thresholds chosen for < 1% false positives per week; for these two species, predictions at thresholds with 15% (pygmy owl) and 42% (flammulated owl) false-positive rates were manually validated. Detection histories, ARUhours and BOpresence are from the authors' corrected files (FLM/NPO/GHO_datas_stacked.csv), sent by J. Barry by email on 2026-11-06, which supersede the deposited csvs of Dryad version 394914: typos in recorder recovery dates at about a dozen sites had put not-surveyed weeks in the wrong place, and one 2018 barred owl detection was assigned to the wrong ARU. Changes against the deposit (same Site x Year x week): FLM 11 detection cells (NA->0 7, NA->1 1, 1->NA 2, 0->1 1), 12 ARUhours cells, BOpresence 1->0 at one site-year; NPO 10 detection cells (NA->0 8, NA->1 1, 1->NA 1), 11 ARUhours cells, the same BOpresence change, and one site-year the deposit lacked (Site 480, 2018); GHO 17 detection cells (NA->0 16, 0->1 1), 9 ARUhours cells, BOpresence 1->0 at one cell-year. The authors will update the public copy; the table will be rebuilt from it then. obs_aruhours is ARUhours as deposited: the README calls it total recording hours in the week, but the values are the natural log of the hours (confirmed by the first author by email), rounded to 2 dp (4.43 = ln 84, a full week of 12-hour nights), and 0 where the week was not recorded; exp(obs_aruhours) recovers the hours. Fire and removal covariates are computed over species-specific home-range buffers (flammulated owl 50 ha and northern pygmy owl 300 ha around the ARU; great horned owl 700 ha around the cell centre). unit_removal_treat: buffer overlaps a barred owl removal home range (2,004 ha around each removal); unit_fire_treat: any high-severity fire (MTBS) in the buffer; period_psev_yrs: proportion of the buffer burned at high severity, any year post-fire; period_psev1-3: that proportion in year 1, 2, 3 after the fire (0 otherwise); period_season_ba: removal site in its post-removal years (the deposit's SeasonBA, identical to PostRemovalImpact); period_b1-b3: removal site 1, 2, 3+ years after removal; period_post_removal_psev1-3, period_post_removal_psev_yrs: removal followed by high-severity fire, by years since fire and for all post-fire years. period_bo_presence: a barred owl detected at either ARU of the cell that year (the authors' acoustic survey; a detection covariate in their models). unit_topo_tr: terrain ruggedness within 390 m of the ARU (cell centre for GHO), standardised as deposited. Covariates suffixed _50ha belong with taxon FLM and _300ha with NPO; each is constant at its level. unit_site is the Site id of the deposited files. Sibling table: barry_2025_sierra_gho_occ (great horned owl, cell units).
